svg.title: The systems of this series on the two choices
svg.desc: The five memory systems of this series and the two baselines, on two axes: who writes the memory (nobody, a pipeline, the answering agent, a background process) and whether the read path inserts everything or selects. Nobody writes: full context inserts the whole history; plain retrieval selects with BM25 over the raw turns. A pipeline writes: Mem0 and Zep/Graphiti select. The answering agent writes: Letta inserts its core memory blocks, and its archival store is searched. A background process writes: textual memory inserts one profile; Honcho selects among its conclusions.
